scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.android:sync: npm --prefix client run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm --prefix client run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
